description: This file implements the KernelLogServer class, which monitors kernel logs, processes log messages, detects specific log patterns, and manages event subscriptions. It reads logs from a file descriptor, writes to a log file, and triggers callbacks based on log content.

classes.name: KernelLogServer
classes.description: Manages kernel log monitoring, including reading logs, processing messages, detecting patterns, and handling event subscriptions.

methods.name: KernelLogServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log server with a pipe file descriptor and log filename.

methods.name: BeforeSelect
methods.description: Prepares the file descriptor set for select by adding the pipe file descriptor.

methods.name: AfterSelect
methods.description: Handles actions after select indicates the pipe file descriptor is ready.

methods.name: SubscribeToEvents
methods.description: Adds a callback to the list of subscribers for log events.

methods.name: HandleIncomingMessage
methods.description: Reads and processes incoming log messages, writes logs to file, detects specific patterns, and triggers callbacks.
